prompt_en:
Goal: Create a vertical ornate anime fantasy “fruit fairy diagnosis” result card featuring のぞむ as a luminous Shine Muscat grape fairy.

Canvas: Portrait 2:3 composition, highly detailed, soft sunlit greenhouse or grape arbor background with green leaves, bokeh, sparkling dew, hanging crystal droplets, and clusters of pale green grapes. Use a delicate watercolor-anime style with luxury fantasy illustration polish, pastel ivory, mint green, champagne gold, and translucent aquamarine.

Main subject: On the right side, draw one young fairy girl with light brown ash-blonde hair in a loose side ponytail, large hazel-green eyes, rosy cheeks, and a gentle smile. She holds one single Shine Muscat grape near her face. Her hair is decorated with exactly one floral hairpiece made of small white blossoms, green grapes, leaves, ribbons, and dangling jewels. She wears a sheer off-shoulder fairy dress in white, pale green, and crystal tones, covered with bead chains, tiny flowers, grape motifs, ruffled transparent sleeves, and iridescent gems. Add large transparent insect-like fairy wings with gold vein lines and dew drops extending behind her. Place additional Shine Muscat grape clusters around the lower right and upper background, plus sliced green fruit at the bottom.

Layout: Make the image feel like a collectible diagnosis/result sheet. Use ornate gold filigree frames, botanical borders, laurel motifs, and translucent parchment panels. Put one tall main information panel on the left, one smaller status panel at bottom left, and one feature panel at bottom right. The subject overlaps the panels slightly but remains the visual focus.

Left main information panel: At the top, include the Japanese headline 果物妖精診断 with the small English subtitle “FRUIT FAIRY DIAGNOSIS.” Below it show the name のぞむ with romanization “Nozomu.” Add a section for the diagnosed fruit using Japanese fruit name シャインマスカット and English “Shine Muscat,” with an illustration of exactly one bunch of pale green grapes. Add fairy type text in Japanese and English: “Daylight Muscat Fairy.” Add fruit rank with a crown and very large gold serif letters SSR, surrounded by laurel branches. Include a short blessing line in Japanese-style decorative text at the bottom.

Bottom-left status panel: Include exactly 8 status rows, each with a small green gem or grape icon, a Japanese label, a thin horizontal green progress bar, and a number at the right. The 8 visible values are: transparency 97, sparkle 94, healing level 98, sweetness 92, fragrance 96, freshness 95, blessing level 93, and fruit-juice magic 97. Title this panel “STATUS” beneath a Japanese status heading.

Bottom-right feature panel: Include exactly 3 bullet points with green gem icons describing the fruit characteristics: refreshing sweetness and elegant fragrance; juicy, shining pulp; gentle hands that bring healing and happiness. Decorate with a green wax seal stamped with a grape emblem and two ribbon tails.

Visual style: Ultra-detailed Japanese anime illustration, ethereal, elegant, high-key lighting, sparkling highlights, soft focus depth of field, gold ornamental typography, translucent layers, crystal reflections, delicate botanical fantasy. Keep the overall mood pure, luxurious, fresh, and magical.

Constraints: Use exactly 1 main fairy character, 1 left main info panel, 1 bottom-left status panel, 1 bottom-right feature panel, 8 status rows, and 3 feature bullets. Avoid modern UI styling, harsh shadows, dark colors, extra characters, or watermarks.\

title: 舒适的午后阳光休息室肖像
author: @PROMPT アトリエ｜AI画像プロンプト
categories: 社交媒体帖子,头像 / 个人资料,摄影,肖像 / 自拍,网红 / 模特
prompt_en:
Subject: Afternoon Sunshine

Person/Expression:
A 20s woman with a mature, calm face, natural black-brown medium hair, and light, airy bangs. Transparent and elegant Japanese-style photo makeup, keeping the skin's natural texture without excessive smoothing. Looking quietly at the camera with a gentle, slightly relaxed expression at the corners of the mouth.

Clothing/Pose:
Light pink beige ribbed bra top and matching short pants-style loungewear. Fine lace at the edges, non-transparent, elegant and healthy exposure. Reclining diagonally on a low rattan lounge chair, head leaning against a cushion in the back right. The subject's right arm extends naturally toward the front of the screen with fingers relaxed. The left arm is lightly bent above the head, wrist near the cushion. Legs enter prominently in the front left, with one knee slightly bent for perspective. The whole body is relaxed but in a posture that doesn't look sloppy.

Background/Light:
A quiet room in an apartment. Wooden floor, light beige cushions, rattan chair, large window with thin white curtains in the back right. Minimal furniture and decor, low lived-in feel. Low afternoon natural light enters from the window in the back right, softly illuminating the face, shoulders, arms, and upper surfaces of the legs. Shadows fall toward the bottom left, with warm reflected light from the wooden floor returning faintly to the skin. The background is bright, and the subject is enveloped in warm-toned light.

Composition/Camera:
Landscape 4:3. Close-up portrait with a slightly low angle. The subject's legs are prominently placed in the front left, face toward the top right. A diagonal composition where body lines flow from bottom left to top right. Focus on the face and upper body, with the legs in the foreground and the background slightly softly blurred. Natural perspective closer to wide-angle, an intimate distance characteristic of indoor photography. Finished as a Japanese-style photo of relaxing indoors in the afternoon without being overly sexual.

Texture/Style:
High-quality Japanese photography, natural light portrait, soft warm tones, pale beige and pink color scheme. Pores and fine shading are left slightly on the skin, avoiding a plastic look. Careful expression of the rib texture of the fabric, the fineness of the lace, and the material feel of the rattan and cushions. Low contrast, no excessive white blowing, with a soft graininess similar to film photography.

Negative:
Minor, childish face, excessive sexual expression, naked, exposure, see-through clothes, exposure of private parts, excessive emphasis on chest or waist, vulgar poses, brand logos, text, watermarks, same face duplication, unnatural face or gaze, broken fingers, extra fingers, fusion of hands and feet, broken joints, floating feeling, unnatural gravity, shadows inconsistent with light source, excessive skin correction, plastic skin, excessive HDR, too strong sharpening, obvious AI feel.\

title: 粉彩尘世界地标
author: 两斤
categories: 海报 / 传单,极简主义,水彩,建筑 / 室内,抽象 / 背景
prompt_en:
Goal: Create an ultra-minimalist abstract poster showing exactly 6 iconic world landmarks as delicate pastel pigment-dust illustrations, as if each landmark is partially deconstructed and dissolving into colorful powder.

Canvas: Vertical 2:3 white canvas, clean gallery-print layout, lots of empty white space, no border, no title, no captions, no watermark.

Layout: Arrange the 6 landmarks in a balanced 2-column by 3-row grid with generous spacing. Each landmark should be centered within its cell and isolated from the others.

Subject details: Include exactly these 6 discrete landmark illustrations: 1) top-left: Eiffel Tower, tall iron lattice silhouette with an arched base; 2) top-right: Statue of Liberty, raised torch and crown clearly recognizable; 3) middle-left: Big Ben clock tower, Gothic tower with visible clock face; 4) middle-right: Sydney Opera House, low horizontal harbor silhouette with multiple sail-like shells; 5) bottom-left: Burj Khalifa, very tall tapering skyscraper with a thin spire and faint surrounding skyline; 6) bottom-right: Tokyo Tower, red lattice broadcast tower with a pointed antenna.

Visual style: Ultra minimalist watercolor-and-stippling fusion, built from thick colorful stippling, pixel-like pigment particles, speckles, and airy powder clouds. The landmarks should remain instantly recognizable through fine linework and silhouette, but their edges and lower sections should dissolve into vibrant pastel rainbow dust. Use soft cotton-candy colors: pink, cyan, turquoise, lavender, peach, yellow, coral, and light blue. Pigment clouds should bloom around each base and partially up the sides, with scattered dots and mist fading into the white background.

Rendering constraints: Keep the background pure white and uncluttered. Use no readable text. Make each landmark delicate, luminous, and semi-transparent in places, with fine architectural detail visible through the color dust. Avoid photorealism, heavy shadows, dark backgrounds, or dense scenery. The overall mood should be dreamy, magical, clean, and collectible, like a set of pastel travel icons dissolving into candy-colored powder.\

Goal: Create a vertical collector's-edition editorial sports poster for CRISTIANO RONALDO, with a distressed archival print aesthetic and bold typographic layout.

Canvas: Tall portrait poster, approximately 2:3 aspect ratio, warm off-white paper background with visible grain, scratches, ink smudges, registration marks, thin grid lines, crop marks, crosshair targets, and technical drafting annotations.

Main composition: Place an extreme close-up black-and-white halftone portrait of the athlete on the right half, cropped so only the right side of the head, ear, neck, and shoulder are visible. The face area is covered by a large muted taupe-gray vertical rectangle occupying much of the upper-right center, creating an editorial censor-block effect. The portrait should feel high-contrast, gritty, screen-printed, and partially erased with rough white brush textures.

Typography and layout: On the upper left, set the headline in tall condensed bold sans-serif uppercase: CRISTIANO RONALDO. Above it, add a tiny orange label “CR7”. Beneath the headline, add small spaced orange text: “COLLECTOR EDITION”. Dominating the left-center, place a huge distressed orange number 7, with small vertical white text “CR7” embedded near the top-left of the number. Across the lower-left corner, place enormous cropped black letters “CR”, partially cut off by the poster edge.

Visible small text and annotations: Include exactly 5 career timeline entries in tiny black text on the left: “2002 SPORTING CP”, “2003 MANCHESTER UNITED”, “2009 REAL MADRID”, “2018 JUVENTUS”, and “2021 MANCHESTER UNITED”. Add “2023 AL NASSR” beneath them. Add vertical orange text “PORTUGAL” beside a small Portugal crest icon. Add vertical orange text “THE STANDARD” near the large number. Add a small motivational word stack inside the lower-left black typography: “DISCIPLINE”, “AMBITION”, “OBSESSION”, “LEGACY”. At the bottom center, add the quote: TALENT WITHOUT WORKING HARD IS NOTHING. Add small coordinate labels near the top, including “40.7128° N” and “74.0060° W”, plus orange serial text “001/1985” in the top-right corner. Add tiny Nike-style sports branding at the bottom-left with an orange swoosh and small text “NIKE FOOTBALL TRAINING DIVISION”.

Graphic elements: Use exactly 1 huge orange numeral, exactly 1 huge cropped black “CR” monogram, exactly 1 small Portugal crest, exactly 1 orange swoosh logo, exactly 2 crosshair target symbols near the top corners, and multiple thin technical grid lines and measurement ticks. Keep all design elements flat and print-like, with no glossy 3D effects.

Color palette: Aged ivory paper, deep black ink, faded charcoal portrait tones, vivid burnt orange accents, and muted taupe-gray for the large face-block rectangle.

Style constraints: Premium football memorabilia poster, Swiss editorial grid mixed with grunge screenprint texture, museum-archive collector card energy, high contrast, asymmetrical layout, distressed ink edges, subtle paper aging, no photorealistic background scene, no extra people, no additional large text beyond the specified typography.\

The character looks like they came to say hello after moving in next door. Apply effects to make it look like they are truly on the screen. Layout: At the very top center, place a small thin line of text reading 中国诗词座右铭 01 with short horizontal rules on both sides. The left half contains the large main title in bold black Chinese brush calligraphy, rough and dry-brushed. Beneath it, place a small red square seal, a short horizontal divider line, and then the two-line main quote in smaller but still expressive brush calligraphy. The right half contains an ink illustration of a traditional sailboat riding stylized ocean waves, with flowing wind lines and cloud motifs above it. Use dark navy-black ink for the waves and black linework for the boat, with a red oval seal near the upper right.

Bottom information band: Create exactly 3 bordered rectangular cards across the bottom, separated by vertical rules. Card 1 on the left is the source card: include a tiny mountain icon, the label “Author / Source”, the text 李白《行路难》, and one red square seal. Card 2 in the center is the keyword card: include the label “Keywords”, the text 志向 / 时机 / 出发, and one small circular wave emblem. Card 3 on the right is the logic card: include the label “Sentence Logic”, the explanatory text “Hold your belief during a low valley; when the wind arrives, set sail actively.”, and one red circular seal. At the very bottom center outside the cards, add small English text: “MOTTO FROM CLASSICAL CHINESE POETRY / 01 OF 10”.

Visual style: Use monochrome black ink, dark navy wave accents, and muted cinnabar red seals only. The image should feel like a thought specimen made from stone rubbing, ancient book typography, Chinese seal carving, and weathered banknote engraving. Keep generous negative space, elegant asymmetry, tactile paper texture, imperfect ink edges, and hand-printed registration flaws.

Constraints: Use exactly 3 bottom cards, exactly 4 red seal marks total, exactly 1 sailboat, exactly 3 main wave clusters, and no modern objects, gradients, glossy effects, photos, QR codes, watermarks, or extra logos.\

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a dense architectural infographic sheet for a historic Chinese circular temple reconstruction, combining precise blueprint annotations with a realistic cutaway construction model.

Canvas: Portrait 4:5 architectural presentation board on warm off-white paper, high resolution, clean margins, fine gray technical linework, subtle paper grain, no border or watermark.

Main subject: A large central 3D isometric render of the Temple of Heaven-style circular wooden hall under construction, labeled with a vertical hanging plaque reading 祈年殿. The building has exactly 3 stacked dark blue-gray tiled roofs with upturned eaves, a gold spherical finial on top, red-brown wooden walls and columns, decorative blue-green-gold bands, and a right-side exposed bamboo/wood scaffolding framework showing the construction process. Place the building on a round white stone terrace with exactly 4 visible staircases. Add small construction activity around it: exactly 15 miniature workers in muted gray-brown clothing, 1 ox pulling a cart, 2 small handcarts, 1 wooden wheelbarrow, 1 stack of blue roof tiles, multiple timber beams and stone blocks, all scaled like an architectural model.

Layout: Use a balanced blueprint poster composition. The central 3D temple occupies the lower center and right half. Surround it with exactly 8 technical information panels: 1 title/project overview block at upper left, 1 top plan drawing at top center, 1 front elevation drawing at upper right, 1 total floor plan drawing at mid-left, 1 section drawing at mid-right, 1 structural exploded diagram at lower left, 2 node detail drawings at bottom left, and 1 material list column at right. Keep all diagrams monochrome pale gray like pencil/CAD drawings, with thin dimension lines, arrows, scale notes, and small Chinese annotations.

Text content: Large main title at upper left: 天坛. Subtitle below it: 建筑营造过程示意图. Project overview heading: preserve Chinese text 工程概况, followed by small Chinese fields for name, location, year, building type, structure, and construction craft. Use scale labels such as “平面图 1:200”, “立面图 1:200”, “剖面图 1:200”, “总平面图 1:600”, “结构分解图”, and “节点大样图”. The right column is headed “主要材料表” and lists categories for wood, roof tiles, stone, and other materials. Keep the Chinese characters crisp, correctly formed, and readable.

Diagram details: The top plan panel shows a circular radial plan with concentric rings and dimension marks including values like 1000, 1900, 2800, and 3600. The total floor plan shows a smaller circular plan with square dimension frame and values around 3000, 5000, and 3080. The elevation and section panels show a three-tier temple silhouette with horizontal height markers around 0.000, 7.680, 15.590, 24.650, and 35.550, plus base width dimensions. The exploded structure panel shows a stacked pagoda-like skeleton with labels for roof, boards, tiles, beams, columns, and platform. The two node detail drawings show close-up roof eave joinery and column bracket structure, each marked 1:10.

Visual style: Hybrid of museum architectural drawing, Chinese heritage conservation blueprint, and realistic miniature construction diorama. Use restrained colors: ivory background, graphite gray drawings, dark slate-blue roof tiles, warm ochre scaffolding, red lacquer wood, gold finial, white stone terrace. Lighting is soft from upper left with gentle shadows under the model. Maintain a professional, information-dense technical poster look.

Constraints: Preserve exactly 8 surrounding technical information panels and exactly 3 roof tiers. Do not add modern machinery, English headings, people in modern safety helmets, logos, or decorative borders. Prioritize legible Chinese typography and clean diagram alignment.\

Specification block: Below the copy, create exactly 5 labeled specification rows in Japanese with a thin vertical gold rule at the left. The 5 rows are: 1) 「メーカー： ルミエール・クレール」, 2) 「種類： オーバルフレーム」, 3) 「モデル名： エトワール・Douce」 with small furigana-like 「ドゥース」 underneath, 4) 「想定度数： ±0.50 ～ ±2.00」, 5) 「価格： ¥16,800（税込）」. She wears an ivory ribbed knit cardigan, a white ruffled high-neck blouse, a beige ribbon bow at the collar, and a thin crossbody chain with a visible ID badge. Her right hand is raised delicately near her chin, suggesting she is adjusting or presenting eyewear, though the glasses on her face are hidden by the beige face placeholder.

Product section: At bottom left, draw exactly 1 separate pair of oval eyeglasses in pale champagne-gold metal with clear lenses, delicate nose pads, and thin temples. Add 2 short Japanese product-copy lines beneath: 「繊細なラインが柔らかく顔立ちに寄り添うオーバルフレーム。」 and 「軽やかなかけ心地で、毎日を心地よく。」

Visual style: Elegant Japanese fashion-ad layout, minimal and sophisticated, soft shadows, warm natural light, delicate gold accents, thin serif typography, subtle paper-white background, polished magazine poster composition.

Constraints: Keep the large beige square over the face as a clean flat placeholder with no facial features. title: Lucian Freud风格运动肖像
author: @VIRENA
categories: 海报 / 传单,油画,肖像 / 自拍,网红 / 模特
prompt_en:
Cristiano Ronaldo high detail textural sports poster.

Background

Raw linen canvas. Unstretched. Unprimed. The natural weave of Belgian linen at 12 threads per centimeter. The specific warm cream of undyed natural fiber before any preparation. The texture of a surface that has its own presence before anything is placed on it. The warp and weft of individual threads visible at close range. The slight irregularities of hand-woven textile. The background as material, as substance, as the thing itself rather than the thing that holds the thing.

The Figure

Oil paint on linen. The figure painted, not photographed. Specifically in the technique of Lucian Freud applied to a sports subject. The thick impasto approach. Paint applied with a palette knife and hog bristle brush simultaneously. The paint building physical texture on the surface.

His skin rendered in the Freud tradition of treating human flesh as the primary subject of painting. Every plane of the face a separate decision about color and texture and thickness of paint. The shadows in his eye sockets in deep raw umber applied thickly with a palette knife. The highlights on his cheekbones in titanium white mixed with yellow ochre applied in single strokes that leave the bristle marks of the brush visible in the paint surface. The skin of the painting as physically present as the skin of the subject.

Pose

Sitting. A wooden chair. The specific wooden chair of a Lucian Freud studio. Worn smooth. Green paint fading to bare wood at the edges.

He is sitting forward. Elbows on knees. Hands clasped loosely. Looking directly at the painter. The confrontational gaze of someone who agreed to sit for this portrait and is now in the process of sitting for it. Not performing for the painter. Not avoiding the painter. Simply present in the way that Freud's subjects are present. With the full weight of a body that exists in three dimensions and is now being asked to exist on a surface.

Kit

Portugal kit worn, not displayed. The jersey untucked. One sock slightly lower than the other. The kit as clothing, not as uniform.

The fabric rendered with the same physical attention as the skin. The hexagonal mesh of the jersey fabric in paint. Each hexagon a separate brushstroke. The stitching at the collar in raised impasto. The number 7 in titanium white applied over the dried base layer. The white paint sitting on the surface of the paint beneath it. The typography of the number visible in brushstroke direction, not in clean edges.

Color

Lucian Freud palette. No black mixed into shadows. Shadows in deep warm earth colors. Raw umber. Burnt sienna. Prussian blue for the coolest shadows. Highlights in titanium white mixed with warm yellows. Never cool white. Never blue white. The warm white of flesh in warm light. The specific color temperature of a north-facing studio window light. The light that Freud used for thirty years in Holland Park.

Eyes

One color departure from the Freud palette. His eyes. Painted in the specific amber-brown of their actual color. The Freud tradition of rendering eyes with obsessive chromatic accuracy.

The iris in three separate glazes. Base layer raw umber. Glaze of burnt sienna. Final glaze of yellow ochre at the highlight zone of the iris. The catchlight in each eye. A single mark of titanium white. Two strokes. The smallest marks in the painting. The most important.

Red Accent

Signal red Pantone 485C appearing in the painting in one zone only. The kit. The jersey scarlet.

In the Freud technique the red is mixed. Cadmium red light. Alizarin crimson. A touch of raw umber in the shadows. Titanium white mixed in for the highlights on the fabric where the light catches the hexagonal mesh. The red of the kit the most saturated color in the painting. Freud painted flesh obsessively. Here the flesh and the kit compete for the painter's attention equally.

Graphic Design Intervention

Minimal. The painting does not need graphic design. It needs one thing. Typography that respects what it is adjacent to.

Typography

Bottom of the linen. Below the painted figure. The unpainted linen. No ground preparation. The raw material of the support visible.

In this zone. A single typographic element. Painted, not printed. In the same black paint used for the deepest shadows in the figure. A broad brush. Single gesture. Uppercase. Imperfect. The letters with the quality of painted type, not printed type. The edges slightly irregular. The paint slightly thicker at the beginning of each stroke and thinner at the end.

RONALDO.

Painted on the unpainted linen with the same brush that painted the shadows in his eyes. The name as part of the painting. The painting as a complete object. Canvas. Stretcher. Linen. Paint. Name.

Japanese Typography

Painted in the same black paint. Upper right corner of the unpainted linen zone. A single kanji.

肉体

Pronounced nikutai, meaning flesh or physical body. Painted with a narrower brush. More controlled. The calligraphic quality of Japanese brush painting in conversation with the Western oil painting tradition above it. Two painting traditions on one canvas. The concept of the body rendered in the two artistic languages that have most seriously attended to it.

Physical Object

This is a painting. Not a poster simulating a painting. An actual oil painting on linen. 122 × 182 cm.

The poster is a reproduction of the painting. Shot on a Phase One XT with Rodenstock 180mm. Raking light from upper left to reveal the impasto texture. Every ridge of paint casting its own micro-shadow. The photograph of the painting capturing the physical presence of the paint surface at 10K resolution. The reproduction preserving the texture that makes the painting real.

Art Direction

Lucian Freud studio practice as the only reference needed. The decision to paint rather than photograph the greatest athlete of the era is a statement about what attention means.

Freud painted the same subjects for decades. Returning to the same faces because he had not yet fully understood them. This painting is the first session.

Print format 70 × 100 cm reproduced from the 122 × 182 cm original. The reproduction at 58% of original scale. Still larger than life at print scale. The painting filling the print. The print containing the painting. Both real. Both Ronaldo.

The entire building is located at the center of the screen, occupying most of the area, with the background environment moderately faded to highlight the subject.nnThe interior of the building needs to be divided into multiple functional areas, each with a clear purpose, rather than randomly piled decorations. Entrance area / Transport area / Maintenance arean9. prompt_en: Two young best-friend women, early 20s, both flashing radiant high-wattage smiles, captured mid-motion in a dynamic product-toss pose — arms extended upward, bodies slightly angled toward each other in playful symmetry. Both wearing crisp white crop tops, bold orange-and-gold color-blocked athletic shorts with metallic accent stripes, transparent PVC windbreakers catching and refracting studio light with iridescent gloss, and pristine white low-top sneakers with orange sole details. Each grips a sleek Doritos-branded accessory bag in bold flame-orange with foil gold typography. Dominating the scene: a colossal oversized Doritos Nacho Cheese bag — chest-high and bursting — with tortilla chips exploding outward in every direction, frozen mid-air in sharp focus. Dozens of chips arc around both women like a crunchy halo. Scattered orange-dusted chips and glinting nacho seasoning particles catch the light like golden confetti. Shot on a Phase One IQ4 150MP, 85mm f/1.4 lens, shallow depth of field with razor-sharp subjects and feathered background falloff. Lighting: four-point strobe setup — key light at 45° camera-right with large octabox casting soft warm fill, rim lights at 135° both sides delivering electric orange-gold separation on the PVC jackets, and a ground-level reflector bouncing clean fill upward. Color grading: warm golden hour LUT with boosted oranges and crushed cool shadows, slight film halation on highlights. Pure seamless white cyclorama background. Hyper-glossy white epoxy reflective floor mirroring both figures and the chip explosion below. Ultra-realistic 3D compositing, hyperrealistic commercial product photography, 8K resolution, Pantone-accurate brand colors, cinematic advertising campaign aesthetic — Doritos × high-fashion street sport energy. 1744x2336\

prompt_en: Create a highly detailed cinematic paleoart landscape showing a wet, alien-looking prehistoric swamp from the early land-plant era, with no animals or humans. The view is from low ground level across a shallow flooded marsh full of mossy green hummocks, slick mud, puddles, and winding rivulets reflecting a cold gray sky. Populate the foreground and midground with primitive vegetation: tall thin reed-like stalks with dark club-shaped tips, sparse brushy thickets, curled fern-like fronds, spiky low plants, bead-like wet growths, and exactly one prominent cluster of translucent pale green oval jelly-like sacs or seed pods in the lower right foreground, glowing subtly with brown vein-like interiors. In the distance, show flat-topped rocky mesas and low hills dusted with patches of snow, softened by drifting mist and steam rising in multiple wisps across the marsh. The atmosphere should be bleak, cold, ancient, and stormy, with heavy layered clouds, blue-gray lighting, damp surfaces, high realism, rich texture, scientific-documentary detail, wide-angle composition, deep depth of field, no text, no buildings, no modern objects.\

title: 雨中伞下的动漫女孩

prompt_en: A luminous anime-style close-up portrait of a teenage schoolgirl standing outdoors in the rain, framed from the chest up, holding a transparent vinyl umbrella. She has dark navy black hair tied in a low side ponytail with soft loose strands and straight bangs, delicate round glasses, large glossy violet-blue eyes, and a calm, slightly awed expression as she looks upward toward leaves and raindrops. She wears a wet white short-sleeved school blouse and a dark blue plaid ribbon bow at the collar. The scene is filled with convincing water and light: rain falling in fine streaks, droplets clinging to the umbrella ribs, beads of water on her hair and shirt, and large crystal-clear drops hanging from broad green leaves in the upper right foreground. In the lower right and foreground, include blooming white garden flowers with dark glossy foliage covered in rain. Use a cool blue and silver palette with soft lavender highlights, backlit by diffused daylight after or during a shower, creating intense transparency, reflections, refraction, sparkling bokeh, and shimmering wet surfaces. The background should be an out-of-focus urban garden or residential walkway with fences and buildings blurred by rain, while the girl remains sharply rendered. Emphasize cinematic composition, layered foreground leaves, hyper-detailed raindrops, realistic translucent umbrella material, subtle rim light on wet hair, and an overall mood of quiet wonder and serene summer rain.\

prompt_en: Create a cinematic black-and-white editorial photograph of exactly three veiled women in Victorian gothic mourning attire ascending the broad stone steps of an old cathedral or historic courthouse. The scene is shot in harsh natural sunlight with deep shadows, high contrast, and a grainy documentary-film texture, in a wide 16:9 composition. The women wear full-length black pleated dresses, long black gloves, layered translucent black veils, and flowing capes or trains; count exactly three figures: one shadowed figure on the left partly obscured by veil, one central figure turned back toward the camera with her veiled face partially visible, and one taller figure on the right walking upward with her back mostly turned. The architecture should include massive pale stone columns, weathered masonry, dark doorway recesses, iron grating, and worn steps with gritty texture. Mood: somber, mysterious, ritualistic, fashion-forward, like a gothic couture funeral procession. Use black-and-white high-contrast film photography, ancient cathedral steps, three veiled women, Victorian gothic black mourning gowns with translucent veils, and somber mysterious ritualistic. Avoid modern objects, color, text, logos, smiling expressions, or fantasy effects.\

title: 动漫办公室女士晚上啤酒吐司

prompt_en: A polished anime-style night illustration in a tall 1:2 vertical composition. A young Japanese office lady stands on a riverside promenade at night, facing the viewer, offering a large glass beer mug forward in a cheerful toast. She wears a fitted dark navy business suit with a pencil skirt, white dress shirt, red necktie, and a company ID badge on a lanyard. She has long straight dark brown to black hair with soft bangs, a slim figure, and a friendly after-work mood. Her right arm is extended toward the camera holding the frosty beer mug filled with golden lager and a foamy head, making the mug appear large in the foreground because of perspective. Her left arm hangs naturally by her side. Add a single white manga-style speech balloon to her upper right with vertical Japanese text reading 「今日もお疲れさまでした！」. Set the scene on a paved waterfront walkway with metal railings, 3 visible warm lantern lights along the path, a river or canal behind her, and a modern city skyline with many illuminated windows in the background. Above, a clear deep blue star-filled night sky dominates most of the image, with the Milky Way forming a bright diagonal band from lower center behind the character toward the upper right. Use cinematic lighting with cool moonlit blues contrasted by warm lantern glows, crisp linework, subtle glossy shading on the suit, detailed star field, and a calm, celebratory end-of-work atmosphere.\
